messages.subject: workflowr 1.70 and workflowr.io
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Version 1.7.0 was recently released to CRAN. It contains a lot of bug fixes as well as some nice new features. Many thanks to Zaynaib (Ola) Giwa, Giorgio Comai, and Yihui Xie for their contributions!

https://workflowr.io/posts/workflowr-1.7.0/
https://github.com/workflowr/workflowr/releases/tag/v1.7.0
https://cran.r-project.org/package=workflowr

Also, I created a new site to share reproducible research projects created with workflowr. If you've got a project you'd like to share more widely, I'd love to include it on the site. It only takes a few clicks to register your GitHub repository.

https://workflowr.io/
https://workflowr.io/docs/

John
